specs.batteryEarbudHours: Up to 13 h (AAC, ANC off); 9 h (LHDC, ANC off); 7.5 h (AAC, ANC on); 5 h (LHDC, ANC on)
specs.batteryWithCaseHours: Up to 52 h (AAC, ANC off); 36 h (LHDC, ANC off); 30 h (AAC, ANC on); 20 h (LHDC, ANC on)
otherFeatures: Up to 52 dB hybrid ANC with transparency mode
Fast charge: 10 min for about 10 h playback
Colours: Lavender Purple and Moss Green (transparent lid), Ivory Gold (metallic lid)

bluetooth.notes: Confirmed on real earbuds (2026-09-25): Android's pairing chooser listed "realme Buds Air7". The official user guide (model RMA2408) says to tap "realme Buds Air7" (no space before 7) in the Bluetooth list, and FoneArena saw the same name. The pattern also accepts an optional space but not 'Pro', so it will not match the Buds Air7 Pro. Google Fast Pair is supported (official guide, and the Fast Pair tile on realme's marketplace listing images). realme/OPPO/OnePlus ColorOS phones show a pop-up when the case is opened. No published Fast Pair model ID was found. The Bluetooth SIG company ID was not verified.

pairingSteps: Turn on Bluetooth on the Android phone.
Leave the earbuds in the charging case and open the lid.
Press and hold the function button on the case for 3 seconds until the indicator blinks. The earbuds are now in pairing mode.
On the phone, open Bluetooth settings and tap "realme Buds Air7" in the device list.
Or, with Google Fast Pair: open the case near the phone and follow the Fast Pair pop-up on the screen.
If pairing fails: open the case and hold the function button for 10 seconds to restore factory settings, then try again.
